reference: Dolostone, Knox Dolomite, Warren County core (Commons title)

description.lithology: pale light grey to medium-dark grey fine-grained carbonate rock, likely limestone to marble, massive to weakly laminated with mottled to wavy irregular banded fabric, upper rows pale grey-white and massive, lower rows darker grey mottled with homogeneous sawn interior
description.alteration: none visible - no distinct chloritic, sericitic, silicified, potassic or oxidised overprint resolvable; pale to dark grey tones appear primary
description.mineralization: tentative trace to ~2 vol% dark metallic sulfides, likely pyrite-pyrrhotite, as isolated mm-scale disseminated specks and cm-sized blebs-nodules

anomalies.explanation: Dark metallic ~1 cm round nodule in centre of row 4 and fine dark metallic speckling on sawn cross-section in row 5 suggest trace sulfide blebs that need close check.
Distinct colour change from pale grey-white core in upper three rows to medium-dark grey mottled core in lower two rows may mark a lithological contact or facies change.
Bottom row core is longitudinally sawn exposing flat faces and top row contains short broken pieces, so verify continuity and missing intervals.
